data: Is the line on the graph increasing from left to right?

The line on the graph is increasing from left to right. The y-axis represents the percentage of searches for "FinTech" on Google Trends, and the x-axis represents time from November 2009 to November 2019. The line starts at approximately 5% and increases steadily over time, reaching around 100% by November 2019. Therefore, the line is indeed increasing from left to right.
